decision: Claw chat is pinned to OpenClaw safeclaw profile with an OpenAI model and now performs a runtime OpenAI OAuth status gate before running the agent.

localProfileProbe.versionSkewObserved: Config was written by 2026.6.11 while command binary reported 2026.6.5; routing still reported OpenAI OAuth usable.

acceptedConditions: requested chat model starts with openai/
OpenClaw status has an effective OpenAI OAuth profile
OpenAI profile count has oauth > 0 and apiKey = 0
OpenAI runtime auth route is usable
routeGuard.clientErrorPolicy: Do not expose raw OpenClaw status output, account labels, env values, or token details to the browser.

notes: Vercel ANTHROPIC_API_KEY can remain for other generation paths, but /api/agent/chat does not consume it.
If the OpenClaw profile auth drifts, the route now fails before agent execution and asks for the safeclaw profile OAuth/MCP setup to be checked.
The status parser accepts OpenClaw warning text before JSON but only stores a redacted pass/fail contract.
